steps.text: Rhodes Island Landship
Outside the Doctor's Office

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Zzz... zzz...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hmm...? *Yawn*

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The Doctor still isn't back after my sweet little nap?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hmph... Next time, I'll just go right in and put my leave request on the desk.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Why is it that every time I want to take some time off, the Doctor's in a meeting? I wouldn't have agreed to take this assistant job, if I knew temporary or not... Hm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: My hair's in my eyes... Ugh.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, Doctor—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: —Doctor?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Why'd you just go into your room without a word... Are you mad? Did I do something wrong...? Hm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: That can't be right. Probably just didn't see me...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hey! Doctor, I'm over here—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Where am I?
Platinum finds herself in an Ursus villa, flanked by a mountain and lakes.
There is also a tall tower far off in the distance.
It soars straight through the clouds up above.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What are you doing here, Armorless?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh... The Radiant Knight...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I could ask you the same.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I work for Rhodes Island too. Of course I can—

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: This isn't Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I guess you're right.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So? Where are we? What's with the tower?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: This... is a place for reprieve. As for the tower, you'll have to ask yourself.
Platinum looks at the tower in silence.
It's not easy to make out the tower's features with the bright sunlight reflecting off its surface; it could also be the unfamiliar angle she is looking at the tower from.
Nonetheless, the tower stands there, scraping the skies like a mirage.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The General Chamber of Commerce? Since when is the K.G.C.C. Tower that big?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: We never left.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: And they never changed.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: That doesn't sound like something the Radiant Knight would say.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hmm... Oh, well. I'm only here to look for the Doctor.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If the Doctor's not here, then you'll have to excuse—
The Radiant Knight doesn't speak. The ever-shining champion simply stands in silence, gazing out at the world.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: What do you need the Doctor for...?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: It's been a while since I came to Rhodes Island. I just want to enjoy some alone time.

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Is that so?

steps.name: Nearl
steps.text: Take that door. You'll find the Doctor there.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Thanks.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's this place now?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: A Bolívarian resort town. The climate's just right, and the service is good. It's much comfier than the log cabins up north.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Roy... First the Radiant Knight, and now you?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Oh, come on, you're not happy to see me?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: I thought we got along better than that, little Platinum?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Cut loose a little. We're here on vacation. The sun's shining bright, and check out the amazing scenery. Don't let work bum you out.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Relax. Why don't I get you some sweets? A nice dessert is just the right thing for people like us, always working under so much pressure. I'm sure you can agree on that.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Waiter! A raspado for the señorita here!
The shaved ice strikes Platinum with a strange, familiar feeling.
The flakes of ice in the cup have been molded into shapes of varying sizes. They've been painted with colorful fruit syrups.
They look just like—
A mountain—
With a private villa?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Spare the unpleasant thoughts while you're on vacation. It's there, and you can't do anything about that.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Or are you saying you'll get distracted as long as it's there?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Well...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: What's the point of having that long vacation you finally managed to get approved, then?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Maybe you should head back and take care of things first. Take a real holiday after that. What do you say?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Take care of... what?

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You'll have to ask yourself that.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: No worries. Leave all the other troublesome things to me.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You might want to hurry, though.
Roy points at a spot of light in the distance.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Everyone's got something they're afraid of, after all.
Platinum looks into the distance. There are three Darksteel arrows bound together as one, blazing through the sky as they let out a sharp howl.

The arrows are fast, but also not that fast. They are so fast that they will pierce through Platinum's body the next second, but they are also so slow that they are no match for the pedestrians' leisurely pace.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: You know your way back to the Grand Knight Territory, don't you?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Yeah.

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: That's good.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You...

steps.name: Roy
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I think you looked better with black hair.
Before the flabbergasted Roy can even let out half a chuckle, Platinum has already turned around and dived into the water.
She's not the tiniest bit interested in Roy's reaction. She simply wanted to say it.
She has pondered for a long time.

steps.name: Knight Scout
steps.text: Miss Centaurea. Miss Centaurea?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Something the matter?

steps.name: Knight Scout
steps.text: Would you be interested in trying out for the knight preliminaries?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No.
Platinum ignores the knight scout following close behind and dashes toward the General Chamber of Commerce Tower.
She imagined the K.G.C.C. building as crowded as the Grand Knight Territory.
But all she sees is statues. All kinds of statue. All pure white, color unadulterated.
The receptionist at the front desk, the security guard at the door, and the staff members walking down the hallway...
All of them are frozen in some unknown time.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Well, this sucks. I don't have access to the part of the building where the directors hang out.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The elevator doors aren't opening, and there's no taking the stairs. The secret passages are sealed shut, too.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm?
Light floods into the building through the ceiling in the center, illuminating the entire atrium with an unnaturally bright glow.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: If I recall correctly... I'm a pegasus?
Platinum looks at the sky above her and leaps upward.
Contrary to what she expected, she doesn't immediately fall to the ground. Instead, she rises higher and higher, accelerating as she goes, toward the ends of the light.
The warm sunlight slowly envelops her—
Followed by the advent of darkness.
Platinum! You can't sleep here!

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Mm... Sorry...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: {@nickname}, do you know what I went through to find you?

options: You sure had it rough, having to sleep on the floor.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Grr.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You saw nothing. Got it?

options: I literally just woke you up. How could I—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: No, you saw nothing. Got? It?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, whatever.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Here.

options: Let's see... A leave application form?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I want to take a long vacation... Get away from Rhodes Island and go somewhere far to... yeah... let off some steam.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You'll let me do that, right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I didn't think of that, Doctor... Did you want to come with me on my trip? Well, we're both here right now. Might as well—

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Uhh... What do you mean by that? Like the coming part, or are you just approving my time off?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Um, I need time to pack, at least.

options: Sheesh. Do you know how long you've put off this tiny wish of yours?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: W-Wait—Don't pull—
She blinks her eyes, only to find before her the thing she's most familiar with—also the thing that she dreads the most.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Another phone call... *Sigh*...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Now we'll never hear from—
The moment after she smashes the phone into pieces, she finds it restored to pristine condition, ringing yet again.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Can't you quiet down a little?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: There's no end to this...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Picks up the phone)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hello?
Platinum, you're overstepping your boundaries.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Right. Yes, I am so terribly sorry.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: And?
The General Chamber of Commerce's authority is not for you to trample upon like so.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Sets the phone receiver aside)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Okay, get it all off your chest.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Go on. I'll chill here for a bit.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hm, if I recall correctly, there should be some booze here.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Aha, I knew it...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Uncorks the bottle)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Pours half a glass)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Mmm.
The Darksteel arrows are growing bigger and bigger under Kazimierz's night sky.
They blitz through the night like shooting stars. Even the million lights illuminating the Grand Knight Territory cannot shroud their luminance.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Is this... sparkling water?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So they drink more than just wine? Hmm... Okay. I'm not a big fan of their booze anyway...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Pours half a glass of sparkling water)

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: To Kazimierz.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: This one's for me, and for you.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: (Pours the sparkling water on the phone)

The moment the water touches the phone, an intense tirade can be heard blaring out of its receiver, but as soon as the glass has been emptied of the sparkling water, there is a brief buzz, and the phone falls silent once again.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So... What will happen when the arrow pierces the tower?
You seem to be looking forward to something.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Malkiewicz. What are you doing here?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Long time no see, Platinum.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I've always been here.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: I can answer your question.

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: 'What will happen when the arrow pierces the tower?'

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: Nothing will happen.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, this suuucks. How come I'm getting you and the Doctor mixed up in my dream?

steps.name: Malkiewicz
steps.text: We don't control our own dreams, Centaurea.

steps.name: Czarny
steps.text: I can be anyone.
I can be someone you are afraid of.
I can be someone you pity.
I can be someone who you show an interest in.

steps.name: Czarny
steps.text: Together, we form that place you can never leave behind—the very place you dread—the tower.

steps.name: Czarny
steps.text: You grew up there. It was your future. You ran from it, and you still feel as though you have nowhere to go. You are confused and helpless.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: The tower...?
Without a single word, Platinum gazes at the dreamscape.
Right as he makes his proclamation, the ceiling starts to open outward, revealing the uppermost level of the General Chamber building.
There are no seats or telephones there.
Only branches extending endlessly into the night sky like those of a tree. At the rate they are growing, the branches will one day engulf even the sun and moon.
Each branch is fabricated from different materials.
Steel, newspapers, wood, and grain.
The different materials all merge into one.
Of the different branches, there is a particular one full of thorns and arrowheads that lets out a sharp roar as it blazes past the winds.
Platinum feels as though she is standing on the head of a giant beast, its wings spread toward the skies, its roots dug deep into the earth.
Its skeleton is welded together from different materials, and all kinds of currency flow within its veins.
As for Platinum herself, she was once an insignificant cell of this beast.
But what about now?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You might be right, Kazimierz.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: But––

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: —I refuse.
Platinum thinks to herself the name of a certain person before she crashes through the window pane and leaps downward.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I hope we never see each other again, Kazimierz.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I want a new life, you know?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oww...

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, you caught me, huh?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I knew you had it in you. I knew I could count on you. And this isn't the first time either, am I right?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So, where are we?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: {@nickname}?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: So there are some things you don't know.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What a surprise.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Oh, don't set me down just yet. I'm not really in the mood to move. Let's put an end to this messed up dream already.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Actually, since it's a dream, it's not like you have anything to lose. Hold me for a little longer.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I need to focus and clear my head.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I need to get all that weird Kazimierz stuff wiped clean from my brain.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: What's going on?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I'm listening. Go on.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Hello, Doctor.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You're in a good mood. Did something nice happen?

options: What's wrong? Why are you taking a nap in front of my office?
You're finally awake. Did you need me for something?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Nothing special.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: I just realized something. It's actually pretty easy to tell dreams and reality apart.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: *Sigh*... Anyway, here.

options: Again? How many times does that make this month?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: You can just deny it. Whatever.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: But anyway, I have something else I want to ask you.

options: Uhh... Let's start with that one first.

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: Do you... have some free time right now?

steps.name: Platinum
steps.text: {@nickname}?
